description: This file contains validation functions for serving cell configuration in a 5G NR scheduler, including checks for PDCCH, PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, and CSI measurement configurations.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PDCCH configuration within a serving cell, checking for unique IDs and maximum candidates per slot.

methods.name: validate_zp_csi_rs
methods.description: Validates the zero-power CSI-RS configuration, ensuring resource IDs are unique and resources do not collide.

methods.name: validate_pdsch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PDSCH configuration, including the k0 parameter and CSI-RS configuration.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PUCCH configuration, including resource sets, formats, and CSI report settings.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PUSCH configuration, including power control and beta offsets.

methods.name: validate_srs_cfg
methods.description: Validates the SRS configuration, including resource set and resource list parameters.

methods.name: validate_csi_meas_cfg
methods.description: Validates the CSI measurement configuration, including resource sets, resource lists, and report configurations.
